## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the gray switch using the left arm

Task description: Use the left arm to operate the raised gray movable button at the center of the light-gray switch base and toggle the switch.

Success criteria: The left arm presses the gray switch close to the end of its target toggle travel, leaving it fully switched. Merely touching the button or moving it slightly does not count.

## Execution tips

- Partially close the left gripper and use the fingertips to contact the inner side of the more raised end of the movable button, keeping enough contact area while avoiding the button edge, fixed base plate, and round mounts on either side.
- The base plate is tilted. Press according to the actual orientation of the button surface, leaving clearance for the noncontacting finger to reduce sideways slipping or hitting the base plate first.
- Press lightly to observe how the switch moves, then apply pressure along its movable direction. If the fingertip is blocked and the switch does not move, adjust the contact point rather than continuing to press against the fixed structure.
